text.tspan: Death rate from cancers vs. income inequality, 1990 to 2019
The death rate (measured as the number of deaths per 100,000 individuals) refers to all forms of cancers and is
standardized for age to allow cross-country comparisons.
Income inequality (Gini; higher values = higher inequality)
Source: Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation, Global Burden of Disease (2019), World Bank – WDI
